# Misfit Mediahouse — Machine Products

Misfit Mediahouse builds hosted tools and agent infrastructure that can be consumed directly by AI systems.

## Machine commerce discovery
UCP business profile: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/ucp
UCP REST catalog: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-ucp
UCP MCP storefront: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-store-mcp
MCP Registry identity: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/misfit-machine-store
The UCP profile currently advertises catalog search and lookup only. Purchase handoff uses each product's existing Stripe checkout flow; UCP checkout is not advertised.

## ChangePacket
Persistent change memory for AI agents. Track public webpages or public MCP tool surfaces. First request creates a baseline; later requests return only the delta.
Product: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/deltafeed
MCP: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/changepacket-mcp
OpenAPI: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/deltafeed/openapi.json
MCP Registry identity: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/changepacket
Pricing: 25 free calls/day; 2,000 prepaid calls for $9.

## GHOSBC Safety Gate
Hosted AI-agent governance boundary. Screen requests, MCP dependencies/tool definitions, bounded consequential actions, outbound payloads, and responses. Public interfaces expose decisions, public-safe summaries, sanitization, and audit digests only; private GHOSBC runtime internals are not published.
Product: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-safety-gate
MCP: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-safety-gate-mcp
MCP Registry identity: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/ghosbc-safety-gate
Pricing: 50 free checks/day; 10,000 prepaid checks for $19.

## ContextForge
Metadata-aware code generation grounded in DataHub context. Public clean-room implementation and demo.
Demo: https://contextforge-datahub-app.vercel.app/
Repository: https://github.com/MisfitMEdiAhouse/contextforge-datahub
